note.text: Teaching a model to be safe at today's size says nothing about whether that safety holds once the model gets smarter, faster, or more autonomous. Capability and alignment are not the same curve, and treating them as one is how organizations get surprised. The practical move is to budget real time and real people for checking systems as they grow, not just when they launch. Safety work that stops scaling the moment the product does is not safety work, it's a launch checklist.
